meta.fiscal_calendar: Fiscal year ends late January; FY label = calendar year of the period end (FY2026 ended 2026-01-25). Quarters end Apr/May, Jul/Aug, Oct/Nov.

coverage.quarterly: FY2000Q1-FY2027Q3, 109 records; FY1999 has no 10-Q in EDGAR history; FY2027Q3 from 8-K ex99.1 because the 10-Q was not yet filed as of 2026-11-19

meta.basis: US GAAP as-reported in each period's own filing (10-K / 10-Q). Q1-Q3 are NOT restated to later presentations.
conventions: Q1-Q3 as reported in own 10-Q; Q4 = FY 10-K minus Q3 10-Q nine-month YTD (derived=1); Q4 absorbs within-year restatements and rounding, see annual.quarter_sum_delta
10-Q cash flow statements are YTD-only: Q2 ocf/capex = YTD6 - Q1, Q3 = YTD9 - YTD6, Q4 = FY - YTD9

eps_diluted and shares_diluted_m are split-adjusted to the post-2024-06-10 share basis; eps_as_reported and shares_as_reported_m preserve the filing's own numbers; split_factor = product of all splits with date > period_end
capex = purchases of property & equipment plus intangible assets (combined line where presented), stored as positive outflow magnitude; acquisitions excluded
cash_st = cash & equivalents + short-term investments (including marketable debt & equity securities); restricted cash excluded

total_debt = interest-bearing debt including capital/finance lease obligations and notes payable; operating leases excluded; 0 where the balance sheet presents no debt lines (FY2007-FY2009, see debt_source per record)
null (empty field in CSV) = not reported and not derivable from the filing

FY1999-FY2009 parsed from the filing's HTML or EDGAR text tables (unit scale read from each table header); FY2010+ from own-filing XBRL (instance exhibits through FY2020Q1, inline XBRL from FY2020Q2); FY2010Q1 from 10-Q HTML tables (no XBRL instance filed)
restatement_notes: FY2007: Q2 10-Q six-month column carries a revised Q1 (+0.684 after tax) plus +0.704 cumulative effect of SFAS 123R adoption; quarter-sum delta recorded on the annual record
FY2017: Q3 10-Q YTD carries restated Q1/Q2 (Q1 net income 196 as reported in its own 10-Q vs 208 restated); delta -21 recorded on the annual record
FY2003Q1 diluted EPS 0.47 uses the if-converted numerator 85.910 = net income 83.245 + 2.665 after-tax convertible interest (Note 4); eps x shares therefore exceeds net income by design
Other quarter-sum deltas of +/-1 are rounding between filings
